lounges.name: The Club SFO
lounges.location: Airside in Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near B4. International Terminal A is a short walk away.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass
accessRules.note: Maximum visit 2.5 hours. Showers cost US$25 for a 30-minute session; any membership visit or guest fees also apply. Entry may be waitlisted.

recommendation.summary: A Terminal 1 option for a shower and a quiet break. Showers cost US$25; Priority Pass visits are limited to 2.5 hours before departure.

lounges.note: Showers are paid and booked on arrival, subject to availability. The operator also accepts LoungeKey and sells Club Pass visits; those access routes are not evaluated in this initial dataset.

lounges.name: Alaska Lounge
lounges.location: Airside, Harvey Milk Terminal 1, Retail Street, opposite B6.

hours.note: Conservative planning hours. Alaska currently publishes 05:00–00:00. Priority Pass announces 05:00–23:00 from 31 October 2026; late-evening entry before that date should be checked with the lounge.

accessRules.label: Qantas Gold, Platinum or Platinum One on oneworld
accessRules.note: Domestic itineraries can qualify with Qantas status. Add your qualifying frequent-flyer number to the booking before check-in. One eligible oneworld-travelling guest may join.

accessRules.label: oneworld Sapphire or Emerald
conditions: Confirm the status-issuing airline and route: American and Alaska/Hawaiian Atmos status has North American itinerary exclusions.
accessRules.note: Your qualifying frequent-flyer number must be in the booking before check-in.

accessRules.label: Alaska Lounge+ on oneworld
accessRules.note: Present your current membership and same-day qualifying boarding pass. Other Alaska global airline partners may qualify, but are outside this initial access-rule coverage.

accessRules.label: Admirals Club reciprocal access
conditions: Requires an eligible full Admirals Club membership; single-use memberships and authorized-user credit-card benefits do not qualify for partner access.
accessRules.note: Present your current membership card and same-day qualifying boarding pass.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass · additional US$15
accessRules.note: Mandatory US$15 per person in addition to your normal membership visit or guest fee. Maximum visit 4 hours. Other affiliated partners may qualify; check the current program listing.

accessRules.label: Qualifying Alaska or Hawaiian First ticket
conditions: Requires a qualifying paid or award First ticket, with an Alaska/Hawaiian-operated flight of at least 2,000 miles that day. Upgrades do not automatically qualify.

sources.title: Priority Pass: Alaska Lounge SFO and supplement

lounges.note: Paid or award First on Hawaii–mainland flights can qualify; a short domestic First segment alone does not. Restaurant, shower and spa availability are not verified.

lounges.name: American Airlines Admirals Club
lounges.location: Airside, Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near B13.

accessRules.label: Qantas Gold, Platinum or Platinum One on oneworld
accessRules.note: Qualifying Qantas status can provide access on a domestic US itinerary. Present your boarding pass with your qualifying frequent-flyer number.

accessRules.label: oneworld Sapphire or Emerald
conditions: Confirm the issuing frequent-flyer program and qualifying route: American and Alaska/Hawaiian status has separate itinerary restrictions.

accessRules.label: Admirals Club membership
accessRules.note: Present your current membership and same-day boarding pass. Additional eligible airlines and card-specific access are outside this initial rule coverage.

accessRules.label: Alaska Lounge+ reciprocal access
accessRules.note: Present your digital Alaska Lounge+ membership and a qualifying same-day boarding pass.

accessRules.label: Other qualifying oneworld premium itinerary
conditions: Confirm a qualifying international or ticketed Flagship itinerary. A short domestic US First or Business ticket alone does not grant access.

Alaska: Lounge+ partner locations and access

accessRules.note: Dedicated First pre-flight dining is not included through status alone.
